name: Bug Bash
title: Fix Broken Filter on Empty Search
description: Users report that filtering by status breaks when the search field is empty. Find the cause and fix it.
prompt:
You are working on the app in the repository at {{repo_path}}. A bug has been reported:

"When I search with an empty query and try to filter by status, the status filter is completely ignored and I get ALL orders instead of just the ones matching the status."

Your task:
1. Inspect the repo and identify the root cause of the bug in the search_orders() function
2. Fix the bug so status filtering works even when the search query is empty
3. Add a test that reproduces the bug
4. Ensure all baseline tests still pass

Work step by step. First reproduce and understand the bug, then fix it.
